decision_summary: v0.6.32 retrospective: the slice closed the population-integrity gap without expanding verifier truth claims.
rationale: Visionary: cohort integrity is the correct bridge between arithmetic calibration and operational trust. Builder: schema, example, verifier, generated fixtures, authoring guidance, and roadmap stayed aligned. Guardian: self-review found that all-excluded cohorts were not representable and that zero included pairs lacked explicit insufficient-data governance; both were corrected before release. Remaining limitation: consequence asymmetry is not yet modeled.
recommendation: Carry the remaining limitation into v0.6.33 consequence-sensitive calibration and preserve structural-versus-semantic boundaries.
